alt: Exercise 3.2 · Q7: In a class of 55 students, 34 like to play cricket and 30 like to play hockey. Also each student likes to play at least one of the two games. How many students like to play both games?

steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&\text{Let }A=\text{ students who like cricket, }B=\\[5pt]&\quad \text{students who like hockey}\\[5pt]&\text{n(A }\cup \text{ B) }=55\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(every student likes at least one game),}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{n(A) }=34,\text{ n(B) }=30\\[5pt]&\text{n(A }\cap \text{ B) }=\text{ n(A) }+\text{ n(B) }-\text{ n(A }\cup \text{ B)}\\[5pt]&=34+30-55\\[5pt]&=9\\[5pt]&\therefore \text{ }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{9}}\text{ students like to play both}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{games.}\end{aligned}\]
